topic: Adjusting session and dwell time calculations
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on adjusting the logic for calculating sessions and dwell time, particularly for a specific mall (ЮК). The current session timeout limit is too short (one hour), leading to data loss. It was decided that the session timeout should be increased from one hour to two hours when no device activity is detected.

This adjusted algorithm will first be implemented on the staging environment for review by someone and Nina before potential use in new countries.

Additionally, this change affects the calculation of total traffic used by 'Пол аналитик'.
decisions: Increase session timeout from one hour to two hours when no device activity is detected.
Implement the changes initially on the staging environment.
action_items: Implement the extended session timeout logic (2 hours) on the staging environment today.
